description: Jahnelle Garcia, MSN APRN FNP-C Nurse Practitioner Candidate for New Mexico HD 27 The 20% reduction in Veterans Affairs (VA) home-care reimbursement rates in New Mexico represents a destabilizing force within an already fragile healthcare ecosystem. New Mexico is the only state subjected to this reduction, other than an area in Texas to match the rest of the state, creating an inequitable and disproportionate burden that threatens agency viability, workforce stability, and Veteran health outcome
title: Impact Analysis of the 20% Reduction in VA Home-Care Reimbursement Rates in New Mexico: Rural-State Cost Drivers and Economic Pressures
